chapters.title: Chapter 701: The wood rules have been understood
paragraphs: "Well, I must become the empress!"
Chu Xiaobei's expression condensed, very serious and solemn.
"Immortal Soul Pill is enough for you now."
"I'll give you some more pills for cultivation and body forging."
Su Lang took out three bottles of pills and handed them to Chu Xiaobei.
These three bottles of medicine are all three kinds of elixir of Three Tribulations, which are three types of cultivation, body forging, and breaking realm. Each bottle contains a full ten!
"Then I will accept it."
Chu Xiaobei didn't say any words of thanks, and sometimes everything was silent.
"correct."
"I still owe you an initiation."
Su Lang patted Chu Xiaobei on the head, "You practice first, I will save the cultivation base, and the storage will surprise you."
"I just want to experience it, don't give me all your cultivation skills."
Chu Xiaobei wrinkled Qiong's nose in shame, "Just your Valkyrie level cultivation base, be careful to be sucked dry by me!"
"Haha!"
"I look forward to the day when you squeeze me out!"
Su Lang laughed, and immediately turned and flew away.
"Huh, it really doesn't change sexuality, pervert, pervert..."
Chu Xiaobei glared beautifully, whispered a few words in a low voice, but did not pursue Su Lang.
Here.
After Su Lang and Chu Xiaobei separated, they went to find Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian.
But both women are still consolidating their cultivation.
Su Lang was inconvenient to interrupt, so he randomly found a retreat room and began to retreat.
Others retreat for cultivation.
Su Lang is not the case, he was for a plan that was a bit nasty before.
The basis for the implementation of this plan is the huge number of Wu Sheng.
The martial artist of the martial sage level has mastered the power of the rules and is a relatively advanced martial art realm.
Starting from Wu Sheng, to Wuxian, Wudi level.
In fact, they are all practicing the power of rules.
Therefore, if there is a way to concentrate the power of Martial Saint, to a certain extent, it can be transformed into a qualitative change.
Su Lang's plan is to refine a super powerful weapon, gather the power of many martial sages, and form a terrifying martial arts power, even... Emperor Wu! !
"Warrior is composed of countless cells."
"The sea of the sky, and even the Jixian Cannon, are composed of many parts."
"There is a lot in common between the two. If the parts and Wusheng are used as cells, it may be possible to create an unprecedented powerful humanoid weapon."
Su Lang thought silently, and immediately took out a large number of forging classics and many corpses of warriors.
He wants to study the mystery of the martial artist's body.
It doesn't need to be too deep, just understand the more detailed structure of the martial artist's body.
Time passed slowly.
Two hours passed in a blink of an eye.
A system prompt came.
"Ding! The wood rules have been understood, do you accept it?"
"receive!"
Su Lang gave the order and immediately felt that he had mastered the rules of the wood system.
Of course, this is only a rough wood rule, including the previously understood golden water and fire thunder, they have not understood the deeper derivative rules.
Take wood rules for example.
In fact, the wood system also has the rules of life and death.
But Su Lang gains the power to rule at this time, which can only greatly increase his spiritual power reserve and vitality.
The rest of the abilities derived from the rules of the wood system cannot be mastered.
To break through from Wu Sheng to Wu Xian, you need to comprehend more complete rules, which contains the basic rules such as the Five Elements.
These rules form the framework of the inner boundary, and then fill the inner boundary with the substances in the universe as flesh and blood.
Derivative rules are rules that most martial sages cannot understand, because they are too obscure and not easy to manifest.
Most Wuxians broke through to the realm of Wuxian after comprehending the basic rules.
In this way, the inner boundary is relatively crude and fragile, and it is not easy to form a real life world, which hinders the subsequent cultivation and development.
But even to understand the basic rules, it is already very difficult.
It is no longer easy to understand the basic rules and form the lowest-level inner frame.
No one knows how many martial sages can't even perfect the power of the basic rules, and in the end they can't break through to the martial arts.
So it's not that those Wuxians don't want to, but they don't have time and energy to spend on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 702: Five founding holy skills
paragraphs: But Su Lang is different.
At this time, his one-key practice rate has reached more than 22 million times that of the indispensable genius.
It only takes four hours to understand a rough basic rule!
"I want to break through Wuxian's words."
"You must understand the rules more, so that after entering the realm of Wuxian, you will be able to pass unimpeded and be more capable of superior combat power."
While thinking, Su Lang gave instructions and began to comprehend the rules of the earth system.
Immediately after.
He once again focused on studying the structure of the martial artist.
However, before he could study it long, another system reminder came.
"Ding! The sea of repair is full, do you break through?"
"Don't break through for now, keep it."
Su Lang issued instructions to continue studying the human body.
Time to shuttle.
Two days passed in a blink of an eye!
Within these two days.
Su Lang comprehended a total of twelve new rules!
It includes soil, wind, poison, and derivative rules of various basic rules.
For example, water-derived rules freeze and wear away, wood-derived rules wither and grow, etc., gold-derived rules are hard and tough, and fire-derived rules explode... and so on.
These derived rules may seem like trivialities, but they are actually very useful.
Because Wuxian wants to perfect the inner world, any seemingly useless rules are difficult to discard in the end.
In fact, Su Lang really wanted to understand the rules of spirit, space, and time.
Unfortunately, he did not practice the corresponding exercises.
It is necessary to have the corresponding attribute of the exercises in order to understand the rules.
In addition to the power of rules.
The cultivation base accumulated in the sea of cultivation base is even more terrifying.
For two full days, 48 hours, calculated at a magnification of 22 million, it is equivalent to a Valkyrie with no lack of qualifications for 120,000 years without any auxiliary means!
However, these cultivation base Su Lang was going to save it to Chu Xiaobei.
So there is no breakthrough for the time being.
"Martial artist's body structure is basically clear."
"The envisioned super weapon can begin to be refined."
Su Lang opened his eyes, took out the saint cauldron, and began to refine the first'cell'.
But at this moment.
"Ding! "Water Martian Elephant Scroll" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "Nine Stars Purple Rainbow Fantasy" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "Black Flame True Sage Profound Book" has reached the founding level!
"Ding! "The True Scripture of Water Mirror Thousand Reds" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "The Secret of Soul Seed Heart" has reached the founding level!"
Su Lang's movements stagnated, and his eyes closed abruptly on the ground.
In his mind, a lot of information about the five holy level exercises emerged.
In addition, various strange and indescribable energies appeared in Su Lang's body out of thin air and merged into his body.
In an instant, Su Lang had mastered these five holy level techniques like instinct.
among them.
"Water and Mars Elephant Sacred Scroll" is a powerful dual-attribute holy level technique that uses the power of water and fire conflict to form a more terrifying annihilation force.
"Water Mirror Thousand Red True Scripture" and "Black Flame True Sage Profound Book" are also water and fire techniques, each with its own characteristics.
Cooperating with the law of water and fire that Su Lang has understood, an extremely powerful attack will erupt.

"Nine Stars Purple Rainbow Phantom", as the name suggests, this is a magical technique with a very high level. Once it reaches the founding level, it is difficult for even ordinary martial arts to find clues.
"The Secret of Soul Seed Heart", derived from Li Xianyang's secret method, can make the martial artist's sea of consciousness contain more soul fire without any side effects.
In addition, there are other effects.

For example, even if a warrior has a heart of resistance, but the power of resistance is weak to a certain level, the cultivator can directly draw the soul fire, but doing so will cause irreparable damage to the drawn person.
In addition, the cultivator can extract the spiritual power of the servant through the soul fire, which is very evil.
If the cultivator is willing, he can also feed his spiritual power back to his servants.
Su Lang cultivated the "Secret of the Soul Seed Heart" for the soul fire of the martial sages. The weapon secret is an important part of Su Lang's "Super Weapon" plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 703: Twenty-two fairy-level exercises
paragraphs: "Super Weapon" is very important.
Su Lang must ensure that the servants who control the'Super Weapon' will never have any wrong intentions.
The soul's heart and fire are sealed in the ghost Xuanyu banner, and of course, you can feel the emotion of the servant.
But how can one put the soul's heart into the sea of consciousness to observe more accurately?
"The soul of the soul in Xuanyu Banner can be transferred."
Su Lang murmured, and immediately took out the Yinhun Xuanyu Banner, and used the secret method to take out the tens of thousands of souls in it and put it into the sea of knowledge.
At this moment.
In Su Lang's sea of consciousness, under that round of Huiyue-level spiritual aura, there were densely packed souls and phantoms.
Each one is a powerful Martial Saint!
A lot of mixed mood swings came, if it was an ordinary martial sage, long time ago, let alone practice, it would be good not to go crazy.
But Su Lang possesses the "Secret of Soul Seed Heart", and his passive ability can deal with these mixed emotions.
Let Su Lang not be affected at all.
"From now on, as long as the servants are subdued, all souls can be put into the sea of knowledge."
"Although this secret method is only a holy rank, it is estimated that it will not be a problem to continue to use it, even if it is effective for Wuxian's soul..."
Su Lang pondered silently, and then issued an instruction, "System, call up my attribute panel."

"In the martial arts stage, every star is a huge gap. It is already very good to have such a rise in combat power."
The corners of Su Lang's mouth raised slightly, obviously in a very happy mood.
"Next, it's time to choose exercises again."
Su Lang focused his attention on the storage space.
After beheading Qian Zihou and others, he seized a lot of exercises.
You must know that those who were killed were all great sages and quasi-sages, and everyone had also practiced at least three holy-level exercises and a large number of god-level exercises.
In addition, he also obtained a fairy-level exercise from Qian Zihou, called "Huanhai Polangxian Jue".

One hundred and eighty-six kinds of ‘natural’ holy-level exercises are collectively called 18 ‘composite’ immortal-level exercises!
At this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 704: The one hundred and four sacred objects are all broken down
paragraphs: "Tsk tut!"
"The average immortal clan is just an immortal-level technique to support the facade."
"My twenty-two immortal-level techniques, I'm afraid only the emperor has it."
Su Lang smiled blankly, "It's a pity, now it takes too much time to practice the immortal-level exercises, otherwise I must practice all the immortal-level exercises."
Next.
Su Lang selected five sacred sword arts.

They are "Sacred Sword of Heavenly Fire and Refreshing Wind", "Recording of the Burning Sword Sword", "Sword Formation of Fierce Demon God Universe", "Light Cloud Pointing Star Sword Art", "Xuanguang Changhong Sword Picture".
"Two days later, there are five holy level exercises again!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched and a smile appeared.
Immediately afterwards, his gaze fell on the ghost Xuanyu Banner in his hand.
"This thing is completely useless."
"And even if you want to use it in the future, it can be refined directly, and you can save half of the materials!"
Su Lang pondered for a while and ordered, "System, disassemble this sacred artifact."
"Ding! Decompose the elementary sacred tool, the ghost Xuanyu Banner*1, and you will get the Soul of Wusheng*2..."
The system prompt came, and a sacred artifact became material in this way.
I don't know if those martial sages who don't have a sacred weapon will feel distressed to twitch when they see this scene.
At the same time, Su Lang listened to the system prompt, his eyes lit up suddenly.
"Lying down!?"
"This sacred weapon actually decomposed into the soul of Martial Saint?
"Who did this, dare to use two copies of the soul of Martial Saint to refine the sacred artifacts!?"
He only needs the Soul of Valkyrie to refine the sacred artifacts, and the Soul of Wusheng is used to promote the Immortal artifacts!
Su Lang only did it once to refine the sacred artifact with the Soul of Wu Sheng, to refine the flying sacred artifact Xiao Bai for Chu Xiaobei.
And that time only a piece of Wusheng Soul was used.
"I'm making a big slot."
"I don't know if the other sacred artifacts are also like this."
Su Lang's eyes lighted up, and immediately took out a hundred and four sacred artifacts from the storage space.
These ninety sacrificial artifacts all come from the martial sages of the Tuantian Tower.
These guys are all at the level of Great Sage and Quasi-Xiang, and each has at least one sacred artifact, and many people have two!
I have to say that they are really fat, and Su Lang's mouth is greasy.
"System, disassemble all these sacred artifacts for me!"
Su Lang took a deep breath and shouted with glowing eyes.

"Ding! Decompose the high-level sacred artifacts, Tuoyue Chongxu Pagoda*1, and you will get the Soul of Wusheng*8, the fairy-level materials...the Holy-level materials...the God-level materials, the soul of the Wushen*23... "
"Ding! Decompose the middle-level sacred instrument Liucai Xuanyu robe*1, and you will get the soul of Wusheng*5, fairy-level materials..."
"Ding! Decompose the primary sacred weapon flying snake chain armor*1, you will get the soul of Wusheng*3, holy material..."
Soon, all the sacred artifacts were broken down by Su Lang!
Su Lang got a total of 563 copies of the Soul of Wu Sheng, and more of the Soul of Wu Shen, with 2,300 copies!
In addition, there are some fairy-level materials, and a lot of holy-level materials!
Tian Le, I don’t know who did it, but to use immortal-level materials to refine the sacred artifacts is completely violent!
And the most important thing is.
The materials used in these sacred artifacts are really too much.
A holy artifact uses the soul of martial arts and immortal-level materials, and the holy-level materials are added to it like no money.
"I don't know which waste refiner did it, it's not human."
Su Lang rolled his eyes, expressing extreme contempt for those Saint-level refining masters with low refining attainments.
Poor those Saint-level refining masters, not to mention that their own work has been broken down, and their refining skills have been severely despised.
I don't know if they know if they will vomit blood with anger.
"Hehe."
"With these materials, the progress of my super weapon project can be greatly accelerated!"
Su Lang licked his lips excitedly, then took out a lot of ingredients and began to refine the'cells'.
The so-called "cells" are parts.
Su Lang wanted to refine countless ‘cells’ to form a humanoid weapon.
This humanoid weapon has dantian, meridians, bones, muscles, and even the sea of consciousness!
What the warrior has, it has it!
And its size, perhaps will stand upright!

They are "Sacred Sword of Heavenly Fire and Refreshing Wind", "Recording of the Burning Sword Sword", "Sword Formation of Fierce Demon God Universe", "Light Cloud Pointing Star Sword Art", "Xuanguang Changhong Sword Picture".
"Two days later, there are five holy level exercises again!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched and a smile appeared.
Immediately afterwards, his gaze fell on the ghost Xuanyu Banner in his hand.
"This thing is completely useless."
"And even if you want to use it in the future, it can be refined directly, and you can save half of the materials!"
Su Lang pondered for a while and ordered, "System, disassemble this sacred artifact."
"Ding!
Decompose the elementary sacred tool, the ghost Xuanyu Banner*1, and you will get the Soul of Wusheng*2..."
The system prompt came, and a sacred artifact became material in this way.
I don't know if those martial sages who don't have a sacred weapon will feel distressed to twitch when they see this scene.
At the same time, Su Lang listened to the system prompt, his eyes lit up suddenly.
"Lying down!?"
"This sacred weapon actually decomposed into the soul of Martial Saint?
"Who did this, dare to use two copies of the soul of Martial Saint to refine the sacred artifacts!?"
He only needs the Soul of Valkyrie to refine the sacred artifacts, and the Soul of Wusheng is used to promote the Immortal artifacts!
Su Lang only did it once to refine the sacred artifact with the Soul of Wu Sheng, to refine the flying sacred artifact Xiao Bai for Chu Xiaobei.
And that time only a piece of Wusheng Soul was used.
"I'm making a big slot."
"I don't know if the other sacred artifacts are also like this."
Su Lang's eyes lighted up, and immediately took out a hundred and four sacred artifacts from the storage space.
These ninety sacrificial artifacts all come from the martial sages of the Tuantian Tower.
These guys are all at the level of Great Sage and Quasi-Xiang, and each has at least one sacred artifact, and many people have two!
I have to say that they are really fat, and Su Lang's mouth is greasy.
"System, disassemble all these sacred artifacts for me!"
Su Lang took a deep breath and shouted with glowing eyes.
"Ding!

Decompose the high-level sacred artifacts, Tuoyue Chongxu Pagoda*1, and you will get the Soul of Wusheng*8, the fairy-level materials...the Holy-level materials...the God-level materials, the soul of the Wushen*23...
"Ding!
Decompose the middle-level sacred instrument Liucai Xuanyu robe*1, and you will get the soul of Wusheng*5, fairy-level materials..."
"Ding!
Decompose the primary sacred weapon flying snake chain armor*1, you will get the soul of Wusheng*3, holy material..."
Soon, all the sacred artifacts were broken down by Su Lang!
Su Lang got a total of 563 copies of the Soul of Wu Sheng, and more of the Soul of Wu Shen, with 2,300 copies!
In addition, there are some fairy-level materials, and a lot of holy-level materials!
Tian Le, I don’t know who did it, but to use immortal-level materials to refine the sacred artifacts is completely violent!
And the most important thing is.
The materials used in these sacred artifacts are really too much.
A holy artifact uses the soul of martial arts and immortal-level materials, and the holy-level materials are added to it like no money.
"I don't know which waste refiner did it, it's not human."
Su Lang rolled his eyes, expressing extreme contempt for those Saint-level refining masters with low refining attainments.
Poor those Saint-level refining masters, not to mention that their own work has been broken down, and their refining skills have been severely despised.
I don't know if they know if they will vomit blood with anger.
"Hehe."
"With these materials, the progress of my super weapon project can be greatly accelerated!"
Su Lang licked his lips excitedly, then took out a lot of ingredients and began to refine the'cells'.
The so-called "cells" are parts.
Su Lang wanted to refine countless ‘cells’ to form a humanoid weapon.
This humanoid weapon has dantian, meridians, bones, muscles, and even the sea of consciousness!
What the warrior has, it has it!
And its size, perhaps will stand upright!

chapters.title: Chapter 705: Hidden Killing Feixu Tengtian's Love
paragraphs: Just when Su Lang was refining the'Super Humanoid Weapon'.
In the distant Headquarters of Tuantian Tower, Yin Sha Wuxian and the three of them were sitting in a secret room, frowning, their faces sinking like water.
Except for hidden killing Wuxian, the other three are all Wuxian.
Feixu Wuxian, One Tribulation Wuxian, Tengtian Wuxian, Two Tribulations Wuxian, Diqing Wuxian, Three Tribulations Wuxian.
Among them, Wuxian Feixu was a man with long sleeves and fluttering, as light as nothing, but this man looked very damn, and his temperament was cold, like a poisonous snake.
Wuxian Tengtian, with knotted muscles, is a muscular man like Chiri Ozhu, but he has long hair soaring to the sky, and he is domineering.
Junqing Wuxian, expressionless, without the slightest emotional fluctuation in his eyes, just like a puppet.
Three days ago.
The news that Qian Zihou and Zhu Qi died of a total of 87 people was known by Lu Tianlou.
After all, it is a quasi-emperor-level killer organization, and there are not only many things like Mingpai, but also more lofty.
After getting the news.
Everyone in Tuantian Tower was furious.
Since the ancient wars, the Slaughter Sky Tower has never suffered such a heavy loss!
A generation of Wuxian Qian Zihou.
There are also more than 20 quasi immortals and more than 60 great sages, which are the mainstay of the tower of the sky.
These powers can be taken out at will, and they can crush any holy race, and ordinary immortals must be vigilant when they see it.
But it was such a powerful force that it was unclear that it was in the hands of an unknown little figure like Su Lang, and died in this small place of Yaochi Clan.
At that time, Wuxian Tengtian was about to take people to the Yaochi Clan to find Su Lang's trouble, but he was immediately stopped by the other three.
Qian Zihou died so fast that he didn't even send out the help message, it was as if he was killed by a spike.
To be able to kill a Wuxian of One Tribulation in a second, the last time it takes a Wuxian of Two Tribulations can do it.

Moreover, Yin Sha and others cannot rule out whether it was only the Second Tribulation Martial Immortal who killed Qian Zihou, in case it was the Third Tribulations Martial Immortal, or even the Fourth Tribulations Martial Immortal! ?
Even if the opponent has the Five Tribulations Martial Immortal, isn't he going to die? ?
Therefore, after the initial anger, Wuxian Tengtian and others calmed down and began investigating the death of Qian Zihou.
They sent a large number of inconspicuous manpower into the Yaochi area to investigate the truth.
Although Su Lang also ordered the strict prevention of the infiltration of the Tuantian Tower, the Tuantian Tower was after all a quasi-emperor-level killer organization.
They are professional!
The manpower sent by Su Lang was far short of this.
Therefore, it took three days for Tuantian Tower, not only to restore the cause of the death of many Wu Sheng, but also to find the battlefield where Qian Zihou died.
Although Su Lang dispatched a clone to clean up the battlefield, the intelligence experts from Tuantianlou still couldn't help it.
From that battlefield, they inferred that Qian Zihou was killed by an attack at the level of the Second Tribulation Martial Immortal.
Moreover, it was also found out that it was some kind of weapon that killed Qian Zihou, not Wuxian.
Because they did not find the unique aura of Wuxian from the remaining fighting aura, but only the pure heaven and earth aura.
You must know that every warrior has its own unique aura, which is contained in the bloodline and spiritual energy and even the spiritual power, which is difficult to conceal.
In front of the Li Tianlou, there was nothing to hide.
But the attack that killed Qian Zihou didn't have the unique breath of warriors.
This means that this attack is a direct conversion of heaven and earth aura, or an attack that uses spirit jade to urge it to perform.
In this case, most of them are using some kind of weapon.
And the need for such a method to kill Qian Zihou does not mean that the person who does it does not have the strength to fight Qian Zihou! ?
After some inferences.
Yinsha, Feixu, Tengtian, and Duanqing thought that Su Lang did not have a master of martial arts, but possessed another powerful fairy weapon.
Because Su Lang originally had the deeds of refining the sea of the sky, it would be easy to understand if he possessed a fairy artifact.

chapters.title: Chapter 706: Emperor head forbidden land!
paragraphs: I have to say that the information system of the Slaughter Tower is indeed powerful.
Within a short period of time, an incident was analyzed close to the facts.
"This son Su Lang is really amazing. He actually refined a kind of immortal weapon that can be activated only by the martial sage, and can also kill the martial immortal. It is unprecedented!"
Yin Sha Wuxian said with emotion, "If this kind of talent is brought into the control of Tuantianlou, our strength will definitely advance by leaps and bounds."
"What's the use of saying these now."
Feixu Wuxian said coldly, "Qian Zihou was killed by Su Lang. We already have an antagonism between us. He must pay the price of blood."
"Feixu is right."
"The Canglan Continent has never lacked genius, nor has it lacked strange people and strangers."
"We have offended and killed us, but even if Su Lang is useful, he must be killed!"
"Otherwise... wouldn't it be someone who has the ability to scratch our beards and touch our buttocks?"
"In that case, where is our majesty and face in Slaughter Tower!?"
Tengtian Wuxian's complexion turned red, his eyes burst out with a strong killing intent, and the surrounding space was slightly distorted because of his anger.
"Su Lang, must die."
Wuxian Duanqing also spoke, and his voice was also indifferent and ruthless, like an ice stone.
"But news just came from the emperor's forbidden area, let us all support it.
Hidden Killer Wuxian had a look and hesitated, "It can be seen that they are under a lot of pressure in the first seat, and the situation is not optimistic.
The emperor’s forbidden land is related to the hope of the first emperor. Should we put aside the things here first? "
The emperor's forbidden area is a forbidden area formed by the head of a Ninth Rank Wudi who died in the battle of the mainland in the ancient times.
In addition, there are five forbidden areas, which are formed by the arms, legs, and torso of Emperor Wudi Nine Turns.
The Emperor Wudi of Nine Revolutions was the most powerful Emperor Wudi in the Canglan Continent for thousands of years.
When that was the case, Canglan Continent and Jingtian Continent went to war, and the Ninth Rank Wudi of both sides died together.
Since then, the Nine Ranked Martial Emperor has never appeared on the Canglan Continent.
After the death of the Nine Revolutionary Wudi, he used secret methods to divide his corpse and the universe of life that he had conceived into five parts, forming five forbidden areas.
He left the forbidden key to future generations to compete.
As long as you get the forbidden key, you can enter the forbidden area to explore the opportunities.
And these five forbidden lands are covered by the power of a special avenue, and Emperor Wu is not allowed to enter.
Once Emperor Wu forcefully breaks through, the forbidden area will self-destruct, and the separated life universe and Emperor Wu inheritance will also be wiped out.

In addition, the death of Emperor Wudi of Nine Revolutions was tragic and praised by others, so those who survived all uphold the will of Emperor Wudi of Nine Revolutions, not only restrained themselves from competing for the chance to become an emperor, but also ordered their own people not to participate.
The imperial forces are not allowed to participate in the exploration of the forbidden land of Emperor Wudi of the Ninth Revolution.
Once someone violates it, it will immediately be targeted.
Closer to home.
The five forbidden areas left by Emperor Wu of the Ninth Revolution can be accessed by anyone below Emperor Wu.
The forbidden area is extremely dangerous, even if Wuxian breaks in, there will be life concerns.
However, these five forbidden areas also represent the inheritance of Emperor Wudi of the Ninth Revolution, and represent the chance of becoming emperor.
In addition, these five forbidden lands have had the opportunity of becoming emperor from the four forbidden lands to be taken away, thus creating the four martial emperors in the world today.
At this time, the six inheritances left by the Ninth Rank emperor were left with the emperor's head and emperor body.
The competition has become more intense.
Therefore, once the forbidden key appears, it will cause a storm and a huge wave, and countless forces will take action to seize the key.
Not long ago.
The emperor's forbidden land key appeared, and countless people died for it, and even the fairy clan was destroyed.
In the end, there were only two forces competing for the Forbidden Land Key. One was the quasi-emperor organization, Tuantianlou, and the other was the quasi-emperor force, the Yongye Immortal Clan!
In order to compete for the key to the emperor's forbidden land.
The strength of the two sides has been fighting for many years, and almost all of their strength has been involved in it.

It is precisely because of this that there are only three or two big cats and kittens in the headquarter of Tuantian Tower, because the real main force is participating in the competition for the forbidden key.
In addition, because too much effort has been devoted, if any third-party forces join in, they will be expelled by the joint efforts of Tutianlou and Yongye Immortal Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 707: Three full days
paragraphs: Therefore, even if the other forces covet the emperor's forbidden land, they can only find another opportunity.
By this time, the battle between Lantianlou and Yongye Immortal Clan had reached its peak, and the masters of both sides made all the shots, and it was time to decide the victory or defeat.
Secretly, I don't know how many forces are staring at Tuantianlou and Yongye Immortal Clan.
Many of them were secretly instructed by certain imperial forces.
For the emperor's forbidden land, the Canglan Continent at this time can be described as undercurrents.

It is precisely because of this that the Hidden Killer Wuxian proposed to support the main force first, and wait until the dust settles on the forbidden land of the emperor, and then come to Su Lang's trouble.
However, some people think otherwise.
"It's just a Wusheng-level force, what's to be afraid of."
"That Su Lang's offensive immortal weapon is only at the Second Tribulation Martial Immortal level. I'm afraid it would be hard to kill me!"
Wuxian Tengtian sneered, "What's more, there are four of us, and there are adults who are not in love. Can Su Lang stop this?"
"Jie Jie Jie!"
"Tengtian is right."
"Su Lang, to put it bluntly, is a waste that relies on external forces. As long as his fairy tools don't work, it's our fish meat."
Wuxu Feixu also showed sarcasm and murderous intent. "The four of us will kill him together. It will never take much time."
"Yes, well said!"
Tengtian laughed loudly, "Let’s kill the Su Lang stray first, and then support the first ones, otherwise my heart is always unhappy, it's like a throat!"
Having said this, he stood up abruptly, his eyes bursting with terrifying murderous intent.
If it weren't for the martial arts all around, just this murderous aura could kill a large group of people!
"Both adults think we can kill Su Lang first...
Yin Killing Wuxian groaned and looked at Wuxian Duanqing, "What does Master Duanqing mean?"
"Half a day, kill Su Lang."
There was not a trace of fluctuation in the expression of severing love, and there was not a trace of emotion in the voice.
"Then go now!"
Teng Tian couldn't wait to say, "By the way, with your subordinates, you can form a thousand sage slaughter immortal formations, and add another Wuxian-level combat power!"
"Well, for a quick decision, take your subordinates."
Wuxu Feixu smiled like a snake, "I can't help but see Su Lang's dying struggle!"
"go!"
A short word popped out of Wuxian Duanqing's mouth and got up and walked outside the secret room.
Not long.
A total of two hundred Great Sage level Great Sage level Slaughter Tower killers were summoned.
They stood under the four great martial immortals, including the hidden killer, with serious faces and bowed heads.
"set off!"
Following the order of the Wuxian Duanqing, the four great martial arts and the two hundred martial arts sages slammed into the Yaochi saints aggressively.
And on this occasion.
Su Lang has refined thousands of ‘cell’ parts for ‘super humanoid weapons’.

After beheading Qian Zihou and others, and decomposing more than 100 sacred artifacts, Su Lang now has more than 600 copies of the soul of the Martial God, and nearly 3,000 copies of the soul of the Martial God!
Using the soul of the of war, you can make immortal tools, and the soul of the of war can make holy tools.
Therefore, Su Lang refines all very important ‘parts’ into the immortal level.
However, all of these immortal artifacts only used a martial sage soul, and like the fairy-level meteorite thunder, a complete artifact spirit has not yet been born.
In the plan, the ‘parts’ of the Dantian meridians and muscles and bones of the Sea of Consciousness are all of the immortal level.
There are more than two hundred bone parts alone.
Su Lang predicted that the number of fairy artifact parts to be refined should reach more than 900.
In addition, there are tens of thousands of holy parts, and there are countless god-level parts.
"From the current materials, to complete the super humanoid weapon plan, there is still a lot of material shortage."
"I don't know what the is Lu Tianlou doing, for three days, for three whole days, they haven't come to beat me."
Su Lang put down a holy part in his hand and sighed slightly.
At this time, another system prompt came.
"Ding! The spiritual rules have been understood, do you accept it?"
"It's another rule, good news!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth was very happy.
The spiritual rules can be understood after completing the training of the soul secrets.
At that time, Su Lang immediately designated to comprehend this rule.
In less than four hours, the power of the rules is at hand, although it is only the most superficial spiritual rules.

"Knock on the Lord!

"Li Xianyang."
"There are people coming from the Slutian Tower again, this time about two hundred people."

chapters.title: Chapter 723: Comes with superb features!
paragraphs: At this moment.
Su Lang is very happy!
There is no way, this time a total of two hundred Great Sage-level and Quasi-Xian-level warriors have been killed, as well as a total of four immortal-level warriors.
It also includes an extremely powerful Martial Immortal of the Three Tribulations!
Just a great sage-level quasi-xian-level warrior, there are millions of superb spirit jade.
And Wuxian's net worth is more than a thousand times that of Zhunxian!
Among the martial arts, every high calamity represents countless years of living longer, and the difference in wealth is ten times a hundred times!
"Hahahaha!"
"Although the use of the Jianxian Cannon consumed a whole 700 million yuan of the best spirit jade, it was all earned back!"
"Come on, let me see, how good spirit jade I have earned this time!"
Su Lang's face was filled with excitement that could not be concealed, "The system, quickly deposit all the spiritual jade and celestial jade obtained into the balance!"
"Ding! All spirit jade and fairy jade have been deposited in the system!"
Wow!
In the mysterious black space, a long string of numbers appeared behind the unit of ‘Extreme Spirit Jade’.
Su Lang counted and found that there were twelve digits in total!
In other words, the number of the best spirit jade has reached hundreds of billions!
Specifically, it is 108.99 billion of the best spirit jade!
"Ding! Given that the current balance is too large, the currency unit has been changed to the lower-grade fairy jade!"
Appears again as the system prompts.
The unit of the balance is changed to the lower grade Xianyu, and the number after it has also become a tens digit.
"In other words, I currently own nearly 1.1 billion low-grade immortal jade!"
"Tsk tusk, I can be considered rich, and I don't know how far the system functions can be upgraded."
Su Lang licked his lips with excitement, and immediately focused on the system function.
There are a total of ten functions that have been activated. Among them, one-key alchemy, one-key refining, one refining array and one decomposition function can no longer be upgraded.
At present, there are only level 24 one-key training function, level 24 one-key martial arts function, level 23 clone dispatch function, and level 23 one-key treasure hunting function.
And, the tenth abnormal function recently activated, the 2-level one-key empowerment function!
All of these five functions need to consume 1 billion superb spirit jade to continue upgrading.
All upgrades are five billion superb spirit jade.
This was a huge sum of money that was completely unattainable to Su Lang, who had only had 700 million top-quality jade before.
But now, this money is just a fraction to Su Lang.
After all, five billion top-grade spiritual jade is just fifty million low-grade fairy jade.
Su Lang has more than one billion!
"This time I upgrade, I am afraid that the first four functions can be upgraded to level 25. I don't know what kind of bonus new functions can be obtained?
Su Lang licked his lips with excitement, "First, let's practice with one key, the system, press the one-key show to level 25!"
"Ding! Consumes 10 million lower-grade immortal jade, the one-key training function is increased to level 25, and the training speed is increased to 44,695,552 times the basic speed!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the one-key training function to level 25. You have obtained the new bonus function ‘Absolute Gift’!"
"Unparalleled quality: the basic training speed will be increased by one hundred times the current one!!"
Messages appeared in Su Lang's mind, and Su Lang who looked directly at him was dumbfounded.
"My fork, unparalleled qualification!"
"Isn't this the capital of Emperor Chu Xiaobei's possession!?"
"It directly increased my basic cultivation speed by a hundred times, so abnormal!?"
"I'm arrogant, the more the system functions to the rear, the more perverted and unreasonable!"
"One hundred times, one hundred times, that is to say, my current cultivation speed is equivalent to 4469555200 times the basic cultivation speed of the Infinite Grade Genius?"
"This Nima, more than 4.4 billion times!"
Su Lang stared at his eyes and turned his attention to the cultivation villain in the mysterious space.
At this time, the cultivator is golden all over, because he has reached a breakthrough.
And now, the cultivator has accumulated three full days of cultivation.
Almost every hour, he can accumulate the cultivation base of a junior Valkyrie to break through to an intermediate Valkyrie.
At this moment, the speed of this accumulation has become faster, and 36 seconds can accumulate one by one from the primary Valkyrie to the intermediate Valkyrie!

chapters.title: Chapter 724: Level 25 One-click Martial Arts
paragraphs: In other words, you can break through from the elementary Valkyrie to the advanced Valkyrie in 36 seconds!
You know, ordinary war gods have to break through a small realm, even if the conditions are good, it takes thousands of years as a unit.
But Su Lang only needs 36 seconds!
This gap is almost endless!
"Too awesome!"
"If I break through now, I don't know how far I can break through."
"Well, forget it, I promised Chu Xiaobei to give her a surprise, first accumulate the cultivation base, and then inject her into her body to explode her, hehehe!"
A nasty smile appeared on Su Lang's face, and then he cast his gaze on the one-key martial arts function.
"The system, upgrade the one-key martial arts function to level 25!"
"Ding! Consumes 10 million lower-grade immortal jade, the one-click martial arts function is increased to level 25, and the training speed is increased to 44,695,552 times the basic speed!"
"Ding! Congratulations on raising the one-key martial arts function to level 25. You have obtained the new function "Six Hearts" and "Ten Thousand Laws into One"!"
"Six Hearts: You can practice six exercises at the same time!"
"Ten Thousand Laws into One: All the practiced exercises will be integrated into one, forming a new special exercise, which can continue to accommodate subsequent exercises for upgrading!"
"Ding! The master's cultivation method is fusing, please concentrate and hold your breath and concentrate!"
A series of system prompts struck.
Su Lang was trembling again with excitement.
Let’s forget about six hearts, a super practical function as expected.
The latter function of the unity of ten thousand faculties completely hit Su Lang's heart.
So far, Su Lang has practiced more than 100 exercises.
But it seems that the number is large, but many of them are low-level exercises.
These exercises have been eliminated, basically useless.
And as Su Lang continued to practice, the holy level cultivation technique currently being practiced would probably be eliminated.
In this way, the combat power accumulated by practicing these exercises will also disappear.
In the end, these exercises became useless in addition to being used as ‘introduction’ for Su Lang to understand the rules.
But with the function of the unity of ten thousand faculties, all the exercises can be integrated and play their biggest role!
Su Langneng expected that once the techniques were integrated, they would surely bring great combat power!
Soon, Su Lang suppressed his excitement, forcibly closed his five senses, held his breath, and entered a state of nothingness and selflessness.
next moment.
He felt countless warm currents rising from his body.
These warm currents vary greatly.
The small ones are as thin as a hair, and they are short and soft.
The big one is very thick and strong, and very long, which seems to contain powerful energy.
In addition, the colors of these warm currents are different, and there are colorful ones.
Su Lang knew that these warm currents were transformed by the exercises he had already practiced.
Immediately after.
Hundreds of large and small warm currents condensed in Su Lang Dantian and gradually merged into a group of translucent crystal warm currents.
But without waiting for Su Lang to observe carefully, the translucent warm current suddenly merged into the dantian and disappeared.
at the same time.
Su Lang felt a powerful and strange energy radiating from his dantian, running through his whole body, muscles and blood, and even the realm of Valkyrie!
Under the influence of this singular energy, Su Lang felt that all his abilities were growing wildly!
Physical strength, reaction power, flexibility, spiritual power reserve, mental power capacity... all attributes skyrocket!
Su Lang felt like he had eaten a big tonic pill, his whole body had inexhaustible energy, and his energy was still increasing!
However, there is no feeling of breaking the body, everything is very natural and all under control.
This feeling lasted for a long time before gradually disappearing.
"Ding! The exercises are integrated, do you want to name it?"
"Do you want to name it? No name yet!"
"Open my attribute panel, I want to see first, to what extent my current combat power is!"
Su Lang slowly opened his eyes, and a ray of light that seemed to see through all the profound meaning of the world flashed away.

Immortal level exercises are already extremely rare on the Canglan Continent.

But in the outside world, any immortal-level exercise can become the town-clan exercise of a large immortal clan.
A Wuxian who has lived for millions of years has only one or two copies.
This shows how rare the immortal level exercises are, and the emperor level exercises are even more rare!
In the Canglan Continent today, the total number of emperor-level exercises in the entire continent is only a dozen.
These emperor-level exercises are basically in the hands of Emperor Wu, and they are the foundation of their lives.
It can be said that each emperor-level exercise technique represents an emperor-level powerhouse overlooking the entire continent!
Once an emperor-level exercise is born, the entire continent will be a storm.
The fierce battle is definitely more terrifying than the chance of becoming an emperor in the forbidden land of the emperor.
After all, the emperor's forbidden land, the Mingmian God Race cannot participate, but the birth of an emperor-level exercise technique is enough to make Emperor Wu come and beat his blood!
At this moment, Su Lang was about to synthesize an emperor-level technique!
From a total of more than sixty immortal level exercises, natural exercises were selected.
The first is the eight immortal level exercises of the four people including Duanqing Wuxian.

Then there are the "Nine Turns of the Immortal Sun True Art" from Li Xianyang, the "Illusive Sea Breaking Wave Immortal Art" from Qian Zihou, and the "Sacred Book of Reincarnation Immortal Pupil" from Cai Liao.
Finally, there is a book called "Praying for Immortals", but it is not a practice, but a classic.
"The Seven Secrets of Broken Love are eliminated directly."
"So, just use the remaining ten immortal level techniques to synthesize it."
Su Lang thought silently, and even gave a synthesis order.
"Ding! After the synthesis is completed, you will get the emperor-level exercise "Emperor Heart Samsara"!"
Inside the storage space.
A dark disc suddenly appeared.
This disc is very small, with only the palm of the hand, covered with golden lines like annual rings.

At first glance, only a dozen golden patterns can be seen, but a closer look reveals that the golden patterns are so densely packed that even if they are mentally observant, they are completely unclear!

"If Emperor Wu saw it, I'm afraid he would take it away at all costs!"
Su Lang's eyes gleamed slightly, "Then tut tut, hide it!"
The successful method actually took a few minutes.

After upgrading a training function and a one-key martial arts function, his fairy jade cost less than a fraction.

"There are so many low-grade immortal jade!"

"Ding! Consumes 10 million lower-grade jade, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 24, the number of clones is +1, and the current number of clones is 24!"
"Ding! Consume 100 million lower-grade jade, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 25, the number of clones is +1, and the current number of clones is 25!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the clone dispatch function to level 25, and you have obtained the new bonus function ‘Cool Down’!"
"Cooldown drops: After the clone's death, the cooling time is shortened from 24 hours to 1 hour!"

Su Lang looked down, and the dragon head of the Jixian Cannon opened its big mouth and firmly bit a weapon similar to Fang Tian's painted halberd, making it immobile.
But this is the immortal weapon Fei Xian Ji Yuan Ji.

Moreover, it has existed for a long time, and its spirit is relatively mature.
At this time, its spirit was very angry, and was struggling constantly, trying to escape!

"It's a pity you followed the wrong master, then, bye!"

paragraphs: "It's quite expensive!"
"To evolve all the Youtian swords into primary immortal weapons, it will consume more than a thousand souls of the martial and more than two thousand souls of the martial god."
"The key is that the soul of Wu Sheng is not enough, I have to refine super humanoid weapons."
"Now evolving all Youtian Swords into primary fairy weapons, it will not raise the upper limit of combat power, so let's leave it for now."
Su Lang frowned, and handed out the remaining quasi-xian-level Youtian Swords, leaving only a fairy-craft-level Youtian Sword in his hand.
At this moment.
This fairy weapon level Youtian sword has already given birth to its spirit.
Its shape is different from the Jianxian Cannon and Sky Sea. It is the shape of a sword, and it can also be called a sword spirit!
The appearance of the sword spirit is almost exactly the same as the Youtian Sword, with black stripes on the white background, mysterious and unpredictable.
But there is an eye in its sword grid!
The sword grid is double-sided, one for each, and two eyes in total.
These two eyes looked quite agile, turning around, like a newly born baby full of curiosity about the world around them.
It can be seen that this sword spirit's natural intelligence is much higher than that of Xiaohai and Xiaopao's two ‘mentally retarded’ devices.
"After all, it consumes so much of my Wusheng Soul and the Soul of the Valkyrie."
"If I refining a mentally retarded device spirit, I will doubt if the system is intentional."
Su Lang grinned, with a slight smile on his face.
Immediately after.
He held the Youtian Sword in front of him, and looked at each other with the eyes on the Youtian Sword's grid: "From now on, you will be called Xiaoyou, don't you know."
"Xiaoyou?"
"You know! Xiaoyou knows!"
Youtianjian's eyes moved cleverly, making a crisp sound like a bell.
"You know how to communicate from the beginning."
"In addition, I learn languages very quickly. It's much smarter than the two spirits that only know how to call Ma Ma Ma Ma and fire cannons!"
Su Lang showed excitement and was very happy, "Great, I want to teach this Xiaoyou myself!"
With excitement, Su Lang taught Xiaoyou Lanxing the language.
Xiaoyou learns very fast, and he can learn the language at almost one point. He has directly mastered the language of Blue Star and has reached the level of Chinese level ten!
His communication ability instantly reached a level similar to that of Su Lang!
"Xiaoyou!"
Su Lang weighed Youtian Sword and shouted.
"I'm here, does the master need anything?"
"Master, don't play with Xiaoyou's body, it's itchy!"
"Master, stop it, does the master want to be hacked?"
Xiaoyou was very excited just as soon as he learned the language of Blue Star, so when Su Lang asked, he began to answer and answer continuously.
"Xiaoyou turned out to be like this?"
"Answer more than a dozen sentences as soon as you ask? And it's saucy and sturdy, want to cut me?"
Su Lang stared, and the corners of his mouth twitched, feeling that the sword spirit also had a bit of sand sculpture.
"What is the master staring at?"
"Don't stare at people like that, it's so shy!
"Does the master want to be poked blind?"
"Can Xiaoyou want to pierce the master's second generation body?"
Xiaoyou and Su Lang looked at each other, each sentence after another, perfectly interpreting what is called Huatang!
"My day."
"This sword spirit is too showy!"
Su Lang couldn't help rolling his eyes fiercely.
Immediately, he quickly put the Youtian Sword into the storage space to prevent it from continuing to talk.
Immediately after.
Su Lang turned his eyes, took back all the clones from the Biyu clan, and gave Li Xianyang an order.
"Li Xianyang, the Martial Fairy of the Colchicum tribe is dead."
"You immediately go to subdue the saints near the Biyu tribe."

This series of orders appeared on Li Xianyang's jade card of transmission.
"The servant must complete the Lord's order!"
Li Xianyang received the order and immediately knelt down in the direction of Su Lang.
His expression was full of gratitude and a hint of guilt.

Because he was favored by Su Lang, his combat power reached the immortal level, but he fell into a disadvantage in the first battle. In the end, he needed the Lord's rescue, and he suddenly felt sorry for the Lord's favor.

"Does the master want to be poked blind?"
"Can Xiaoyou want to pierce the master's second generation body?"
Xiaoyou and Su Lang looked at each other, each sentence after another, perfectly interpreting what is called Huatang!
"My day."
"This sword spirit is too showy!"
Su Lang couldn't help rolling his eyes fiercely.
Immediately, he quickly put the Youtian Sword into the storage space to prevent it from continuing to talk.
Immediately after.
Su Lang turned his eyes, took back all the clones from the Biyu clan, and gave Li Xianyang an order.
"Li Xianyang, the Martial Fairy of the Colchicum tribe is dead."
"You immediately go to subdue the saints near the Biyu tribe."
"There are also the Qiu Shui Xian Clan, no, now it is the Qiu Shui Saint Clan.
If they are conscious and take the initiative to vote, then they will accept it.
If they are not moved and wait for me to come, then they will be destroyed!"
This series of orders appeared on Li Xianyang's jade card of transmission.
"The servant must complete the Lord's order!"
Li Xianyang received the order and immediately knelt down in the direction of Su Lang.
His expression was full of gratitude and a hint of guilt.
Because he was favored by Su Lang, his combat power reached the immortal level, but he fell into a disadvantage in the first battle.
In the end, he needed the Lord's rescue, and he suddenly felt sorry for the Lord's favor.

chapters.title: Chapter 742: Choice of Colchicum
paragraphs: "The first order was not executed well."
"I must meticulously complete the orders the Lord is giving now, otherwise I can only apologize with death!"

Li Xianyang was secretly ruthless in his heart, and immediately returned to the Biyu Saints, gathered all the Saints, went to the surrounding Saints, and included them in the territory of Su Lang's rule!
Su Lang was not interested in what Li Xianyang would do.
With Li Xianyang's Wuxian-level combat power, there is no threat around them. Those holy races either surrender or perish. There is no third choice!
"Just broke through three small realms."
"It is now a nine-star level cultivation realm."
"It's a pity that the skills I practice are limited now, which delays the understanding of the rules and is unable to enter the martial arts for the time being."
"The rules are not perfect. Even if the cultivation level is sufficient, I can't choose to be promoted, otherwise the foundation is not strong, and it will become a big problem in the future."
"The most urgent task is to practice the exercises. The cultivation level can be temporarily put on hold."
"Well, I don't know what is going on in the Slaughter Tower. Will a more powerful Wuxian be sent next time?"
"Should I upgrade the Jixian Cannon? And the sea of sky?"
"Forget it, upgrading the fairy weapon requires more materials than the Evolution Youtian Sword, so let's talk about the super humanoid weapon first."
Thinking in his mind, Su Lang adjusted the flame, looked at the state of the materials in the furnace, and continued to refine the parts of the super humanoid weapon.
In fact, sending a avatar to help Li Xianyang kill Dingbo Wuxian and Huanyu Wuxian took a dozen breaths.
At this time, Su Lang didn't delay the refining of parts.
Time is fleeting.
Chu Xiaobei, Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian have consolidated their cultivation bases.
Originally the three women were excited to find Su Lang, but Chu Xiaobei discovered that after Su Lang was refining the equipment, she took Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian to Blue Star to practice.
At this time, Chu Xiaobei's cultivation level has also reached the nine-star martial sage, only one step away is the quasi immortal. What is needed most now is the power to understand the rules.
She chose not to use the rule fairy crystal, so this process will be more difficult for her.

But Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian had reached the quasi-shen and possessed the space guide given by Su Lang. At this time, they had to go to the blue star to refine the space guide and achieve the position of the Valkyrie.
at the same time.
On the Biyu clan's side, the fall of the two great martial immortals caused a tremendous panic.
All the holy races were plunged into fear, for fear that the mysterious person would get angry and kill himself.
However, when the people were in a panic, they saw an envoy from the Biyu clan.
The messenger of the Biyu tribe gave them two choices, surrender to Young Master Su or perish.
Without exception, all the saints chose to surrender the first time.

Originally, the envoy of the Biyu clan planned to throw out the benefits of surrendering to Young Master Su, but he didn't expect that all these saints would surrender directly without thinking about it.
All of a sudden.

The neighboring races of the Biyu tribe, the Hundred Wars Saint Clan, the Feishhuang Saint Clan, and the Lianhua Saint Clan, as well as the three major Saint Clan of the north and east respectively, surrendered and presented countless treasures of heaven and earth, rare and exotic animals, plus books The most beautiful group of women in the tribe!
Immediately, the name of Li Xianyang spread to the nine great saints and the Qiu Shui saints, and the name of Su Gongzi, the lord of Li Xianyang, made everyone feel thunderous.
The various miracles about Su Gongzi were passed from the mouths of the martial sages of the Biyu tribe and turned into various versions, which made people admire and worship.
In the end, the Colchicum clan finally lost its breath.
Their Martial Immortal was directly beheaded, which was the most feared force in this incident.
Wuxian, almost the figure at the top of the Pyramid of Canglan Continent, it is extremely difficult to kill!
At this time, the martial celestials of their Coliseum clan fell all together, without even a chance to escape!
The death of Wuxian and the mysterious murderer, like a sword on his neck, could destroy their Qiushui tribe at any time.
Of course, there are people in the Qiu Shui clan who are unwilling to surrender and want to resist with the help of the immortal formation.
But these people were quickly killed in the Qiu Shui clan's internal struggle, and the Qiu Shui clan quickly completed the change of power in just one day.
By this time, all the senior leaders of the Qiu Shui clan are people who intend to surrender.
After the internal fight was over, the Qiu Shui tribe immediately sent an envoy to the Biyu tribe without delay, and saw Li Xianyang.
The last time the direct descendants of the Colchicum tribe came, they were arrogant, defiant, pretentious, and lofty.
But this time, the ten quasi immortals who came as messengers all knelt in front of Li Xianyang, and gave their souls and hearts very humble.

chapters.title: Chapter 743: Create a quasi immortal in an instant!
paragraphs: "These soul fires, I will pass on to the Lord."
"Whether you live or die is only a matter of the Lord's thoughts, but I estimate that you have escaped with your life."
"No, no, no, not just escaped with a life, but got a great opportunity, your choice will make your future smooth!"
Li Xianyang looked down at the ten quasi-immortals below and said lightly.
"Yes!!"
"Master Xianyang, I will serve the Lord wholeheartedly, crush my bones, and do whatever I can!"
The quasi-immortals hurriedly patted their hearts and assured.
In fact, from the changes in the Biyu clan, they had long seen that submitting to that mysterious Su Gongzi would gain great benefits.
After all, it is a character who can reward a set of Three Tribulations Immortal Array at will!
Thereupon.
Su Lang, who was refining a super humanoid weapon, soon received the soul fire transmitted back by Li Xianyang.
This time, there were a total of one hundred and thirty-six soul fires.

Among them, there are thirteen quasi-immortal levels, which are ten quasi-immortals of the Autumn Water Narcissus Clan, and one of the three neighboring Saint Families of the Autumn Water Narcissus Clan.
In addition, all of them are martial saint levels, from one-star martial saints to nine-star martial saints.
"It's all veteran martial saints!"
"And there are many Great Sage levels among them, and one is comparable to dozens of new young Martial Saints!"
"Not bad, this time the harvest is very good!
Su Lang showed a satisfied smile on his face, and then put all these soul heartfires into the sea of knowledge.
Immediately afterwards, he collected the furnace and materials in front of him and stood up.
In this day, Su Lang refined more than five hundred immortal-level materials!
At the same time, he has accumulated countless cultivations!
One day's time is equivalent to a nine-star great saint meditating for more than ten million years without auxiliary means!
If you are not restricted by the rules, you can be promoted to a martial immortal.

Su Lang estimated that he might not only be able to reach the Martial Immortal level, but also break through several levels in succession and reach the peak of the Primary Martial Immortal, the Three Tribulations Martial Immortal!
"With so much cultivation, it is estimated that many quasi-immortals can be created!"

The corners of Su Lang's mouth were slightly hooked, and he immediately took out the transmission jade card and gave the order, allowing Huangfu Qin, Yaochi Yanfa, Chiri Muzhu, and Tianyunzhi to enter the Immortal Palace.
"Wait to meet the Lord!"
Huangfu Qin and the other four knelt on the ground, respectfully kowtowing and saluting, their eyes full of fanaticism.
"You are the servants who have followed me the longest, although it really hasn't been long."
Su Lang smiled lightly, "Today, I intend to give you the opportunity so that you can quickly improve your cultivation realm without much effort. ”
"What!?"
"The Lord will give the servants and other opportunities!"
"This time, what a mysterious means is this to directly improve the cultivation realm for the servants and others!?"
Huangfu Qin, Yaochi Yan Fa and the other four had thoughts flowing in their hearts, and they couldn't help themselves.
Moreover, in their hearts, they never doubted whether Su Lang's means had any side effects, and they completely trusted and worshiped one hundred percent.
"Huangfuqin."
Su Lang smiled and said, "As my first soul fire servant, you come first." ”
"Yes, Lord!"
Huangfu Qin knelt on the ground and moved his knees to Su Lang.
"Close your eyes and calm down." Su Lang said.
Huangfu Qin immediately complied.
Immediately afterwards, Su Lang put a hand on Huangfu Qin's heavenly spirit and used the cultivation empowerment function.
Suddenly, like a dam discharging, terrifying cultivation directly poured into Huangfu Qin's meridians and dantian.
These cultivations naturally became Huangfu Qin's cultivation, and there was no need for any refining process at all.
As a result, Huangfu Qin's cultivation realm began to skyrocket!
He was originally just a one-star Martial Saint, not much better than the New and Nennian Martial Saint.
But at this time, the realm of cultivation soared wildly, and the two-star, three-star, and four-star directly reached the quasi-immortal!
With such a scene, Yaochi Yanfa, Chiri Muzhu, and Tianyunzhi on the side were stunned, and their jaws were about to fall.
Only then did they understand how terrifying the opportunity the Lord was about to give this time!
A one-star martial saint turned into a quasi-immortal in an instant, which was really too exaggerated!
However, the opportunity given by Su Lang is not over!

chapters.title: Chapter 744: Wuxian's chance to give away
paragraphs: "This is a regular fairy crystal."
"When Wuxian sits down, it is a fairy-level treasure with a small probability of being able to condense."
"With this rule fairy crystal, you must be more likely to make up for your lack of rules."
"Huangfuqin, I hope you can arrive at Wuxian soon and do things for me."
While talking, Su Lang threw the rule fairy crystal down.
"Master!"
"Woo, sir, I will definitely work hard to cultivate and be promoted to Wuxian as soon as possible!"
Huangfuqin burst into gratitude, and his whole person was almost crazy with excitement.
He was originally an enemy of Su Lang, but was later coerced and had to become a servant.
But now, he has been a blessing in disguise, not only reaching the level of a quasi immortal, but also having the opportunity to break through to a martial immortal!
This is no longer being promoted in the slightest, but an even more unspeakable gift.
If possible, Huangfuqin almost wanted to give Su Lang his soul first to show his loyalty!
Simultaneously.
Yaochi Yan Fa and others on one side also looked stupid.
What they are about to get is the chance to become a fairy!
Achieving Wuxian was originally an unattainable goal in his whole life, but now because of the Lord's gift, an unimaginable opportunity can be obtained so easily!
This is simply the blessing of not knowing how many years of cultivation have come!
"Don't froze!"
Su Lang waved his hand faintly, "Huangfuqin, you go to consolidate your cultivation, and then you can go back to Fengling Clan to take a look."
"Yes, Lord!"
Huangfuqin held the rule immortal crystal and retreated respectfully.
"Yao Chi Yan Fa, you will come next."
Su Lang turned his eyes and looked at Yaochi Yan Fa.

To upgrade Huangfu Qin from a one-star martial sage to a quasi-immortal level, the realm span is indeed very large, and the instillation efficiency is only 40%, but it only consumes a quarter of Su Lang's cultivation.

This quarter of the cultivation base is equivalent to the nine-star martial sage meditating for more than two million years, even if it is half, it will have more than one million years, which is completely enough to raise Huangfuqin's cultivation base.
At this time, Su Lang still had three quarters of his cultivation left.
The remaining Yaochi Yan Fa and others are six-star martial sages and seven-star martial sages, and these cultivation skills can't even be used up!
At this time, Yao Chi Yan Fa stepped forward and knelt down with a fanatical expression.
Use the same method.
Su Lang gave Yaochi Yan Fa a cultivation base initiation and directly raised him to the quasi-celestial level.
Subsequently, another piece of regular fairy crystal was dropped.
Next, Chiri Muzhu and Tianyunzhi also had to go straight to the quasi-celestial level to obtain regular fairy crystals.
Immediately, Su Lang had four quasi-celestial confidants.
As for the quasi immortals who have just surrendered to the Qiu Shui tribe, they can't simply reward them.
A certain contribution must be made to be rewarded!
Raising all the four of them to the quasi-immortal level, Su Lang's accumulated cultivation is still about one-fifth.
"Today's count runs out, save it."
Su Lang stood up, ready to go to the Biyu clan.
The purpose here is to harvest the wealth of the nine saints and the Colchicum.
And what Su Lang valued most was the fairy-level formation of the Colchicum tribe!
"With this celestial formation, my sky phantom and immortal formation can be improved!"
Su Lang smiled and looked forward to it.
And at this moment.
System prompts came one after another.
"Ding! "Sacred Sword of Sky Fire and Breeze" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "Shaoying Sword Record" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "Ferocious Demon Sword Array" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "Qingyun Point Star Sword Art" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "Xuanguang Changhong Sword Picture" has reached the founding level!"
"Ok?"
"Has the five sacred sword arts reached the founding level?"
Su Lang looked happy, and immediately felt the five warmths flowing out of his body, blending into his limbs.
A kind of hot spring-like comfort comes, which makes the pores relax and the mood is refreshing.
At the same time, the unnamed Wanfa Integrating Cultivation Technique was once again integrated into the Five Saint-Level Cultivation Techniques, and the rank was improved a lot!
But the unnamed exercises still haven't reached the immortal level.
"Although I haven't reached the immortal level, I will definitely be promoted to the immortal level next time!"
Su Lang thought to himself, and then opened his property panel.

chapters.title: Chapter 745: Across the sky, the power of martial arts!
paragraphs: "Properties panel!"
[Name]: Su Lang
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Jiuxing Wusheng
[Attack level]: Two Tribulations Wuxian
[Defense level]: One Tribulation Wuxian+
[Shenfa Level]: One Tribulation Wuxian+
[Endurance Level]: One Tribulation Wuxian+
[Spirit Level]: Realm of Sunshine
[Mastering the exercises]: The Infinite Heart Sutra, "Ten Thousand Laws into One: Unnamed" (Holy Level, Founding)

[Activated system functions]: One-key practice function (level 25), one-key martial arts function (level 25), clone dispatch function (level 25), one-key treasure hunt function (level 25), one-key alchemy function (level 15) ), one-key mixer function (level 15), one-key refining array function (level 15), one-key synthesis function (level 15), one-key initiation function (level 4), one-key decomposition function (no level)
"In the realm of the nine-star martial sage, across the sky, has it reached the attack realm of the Second Tribulation Wuxian?"
The corners of Su Lang's mouth raised slightly, quite satisfied.
The gap between Wu Sheng and Wu Xian is really too big!

chapters.title: Chapter 746: Go to see the Colchicum
paragraphs: As soon as he appeared, Li Xianyang immediately felt something and came to see him.
Of course, Bi Yulin and the others also immediately followed, for fear that they were a step slower.
In addition to them, there are the main members of the nine saints and the Colchicum.
Because Li Xianyang knew that Su Lang would definitely summon these people, so he simply left them behind.
"Servants wait to see the Lord!"
Headed by Li Xianyang, a group of quasi-celestial martial sages knelt on the ground, their heads crushed in black.
These are all strong men standing on the upper level of the Canglan Continent Pyramid, but they are as humble as a bug.
The quasi-celestial warriors of the Colchicum and the Nine Great Sages tremble, for fear that they will make a little mistake and cause dissatisfaction with the new master.
Therefore, not only did they dare not even look at Su Lang, but they did not even dare to breathe. They were all tense as tight as a rubber band.
Of course, they could still feel the fluctuations in the cultivation base of the Nine Star Martial Saint on Su Lang.
I couldn't help but feel a little strange.
The master I'm waiting for, the realm of cultivation is only nine-star Martial Saint level?
Could it be, what kind of person is the Lord?
Is it the direct blood of the ancient immortal tribe, or simply the direct blood of the emperor tribe?
Everyone thought in their hearts, and felt more and more that an extremely terrifying force was standing behind Su Lang. When they were frightened in their hearts, there was a contradiction in joy.
The power of the Lord is strong, so of course they have a lot of benefits!
"All get up."
Su Lang sat on the head and waved his hand faintly.
Immediately after a glance, Su Lang's attribute panel of the strong men was called out, and everyone's information was immediately clear.
"You made the right choice."
Su Lang said to the newly surrendered quasi-martial sages, "As long as I do things with my heart, I will ignore the predecessors and reuse your wait."
"Yes!"
"Thank you Lord Longen!"
"The Lord is the master of virtue and virtue!"
"The servants will do their best to do things for the Lord, even if they give their lives, they will not hesitate!"
The thirteen newly surrendered quasi immortals took the other martial sages and bowed their heads one after another.
"Don't talk nonsense."
"I want to see your actions."
"Now, Hyun Level Immortal, you will lead the way. I'm going to see you Qiushui Clan."
Su Lang pointed a finger and hit a glamorous female quasi fairy.
"Yes, Lord!!"
Xuan Jiuxian was flattered at once, suppressing his ecstasy, showing a charming smile, instantly showing a variety of amorous feelings.
Seeing this scene, the other quasi immortals were immediately envious.
It is a great honor to be ignorant by the Lord, and the future is boundless!
But they didn't even know that Su Lang was not interested in the appearance of Xuan Lianxian, just because her cultivation base was the highest among the people.
This Xuan-level immortal has almost half-footed into the realm of Wuxian, and he is considered a talent.
"Let's go."
Su Lang got up and said lightly.
"Yes!"
Everyone got up one after another, Li Xianyang and Xuan Xiaoxian led the way, while the others followed behind.
A large group of people surrounded Su Lang, passing through the teleportation array one by one, across the three saint race areas, and came to the territory of the Qiushui tribe.
The territory of the Colchicum tribe is very large, almost the total area of the ten holy tribes including the Biyu tribe.
And the aura here is stronger and more abundant.
Four cities stand, the strong are like clouds, and the overall strength is a realm higher than the saints.
But Su Lang is not interested in this.
He directly asked Hyoshui Wuxian to join him to the headquarters of the Colchicum tribe.
The headquarters of the Colchicum tribe is a huge lake named Colchicum.
This lake occupies a large area, and the edge is not visible at a glance, just like a sea.
But Su Lang's spiritual power was so majestic, it instantly enveloped it.
I saw Qiuxian Lake like a bright moon falling down on the ground, with autumn waves rippling and fairy aura overflowing.
The headquarters building is built on the bottom of the lake, and it is white all over, and it is natural at first sight.
It has to be said that although the Colchicum clan is a Xinnen clan, after two million years of accumulation and precipitation, the foundation is still much deeper than that of the holy clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 747: Waving and arranging the Five Tribulations Immortal Array
paragraphs: Su Lang stopped on the edge of Qiuxian Lake.
Everyone behind him also stopped, bowed their heads, and dared not make noise.

In the distance, a large number of martial artists of the Colchicum tribe formed a guard of honor and formed a welcoming team, but they did not dare to move forward, and could only greet them silently with an uneasy mood.
Su Lang was not interested in these people either, and directly began to observe the fairy formation.
The fairy array of the Colchicum tribe is the mist that evaporates around the lake.
These mists condense the rules of the water system and some derived rules of the water system, and the defense is strong and endless.
It also has the ability to counterattack in the dark, which can consume the body and soul of the enemy, erode its intelligence, and is extremely insidious.
But this immortal formation was vulnerable to Su Lang's eyes.
Even if you don't need the ability to control the formation, you can get rid of it directly!
"Is this the Three Tribulations Immortal Array of your Immortal Clan?"
Su Lang smiled and shook his head, "It's...the flaws are continuous, you can break it with one finger!"
This statement came out.
Xuan Xiaoxian and the others were at a loss and were afraid to speak.
Immediately afterwards, they saw Su Lang stretch out a finger, and with a single tap, a group of terrifying force of rules condensed and fell into the formation.
"this is!?"
"It's a Wuxian-level attack! And it's not just a Wuxian!
"The master seems to have only a nine-star martial sage in the realm of cultivation, but it is incredible to be able to perform a Wuxian level attack at will!"
"Look! Under the Lord's attack, the fairy array started to collapse in an instant!"
"Our immortal formation has gone through millions of years of perfection, and we think it has no flaws, but it has been found out by the Lord!"

"One finger can break through the Three Tribulations Immortal Array, the master is also superb in the formation of the second generation of attainments, maybe the Biyu Clan Immortal Array was refined by the master!"
"Strong combat power and extraordinary formations. The lord I waited for must be the most talented genius for thousands of years. If there are no accidents, I will be the throne!"
When everyone was discussing, they saw that the immortal array collapsed under Su Lang's fingers, and finally vanished into ashes.
This scene directly saw the guard of honor warriors in the distance dumbfounded.
A good fairy formation, which has been standing in Qiushixian Lake for millions of years, was broken by a finger of the new master! ?
God, what a powerful Lord this is!
Some warriors could not help kneeling on the ground, buckling their heads frantically.
At this time.
Su Lang stretched out his hand, and a large amount of material was taken out from the Colchicum Lake and fell into his hands.
When Su Lang destroyed the formation, he deliberately did not destroy these formation materials, otherwise it would be too wasteful.
Most of these immortal array materials are immortal!
It can be said that most of the accumulation of two million years of the Colchicum tribe has been used in this fairy formation.
Therefore, Su Lang has gained a lot!
However, after seeing Su Lang destroying the immortal formation, the Xiu Xiaoxian and others of the Qiucian tribe directly collected the materials and sighed in their hearts.
The formation of the immortal clan's two million years of accumulation only at night, is that just destroyed.
After the Qiushui tribe, is there no fairy formation for protection?
After all, he was forced to surrender, and he was not treated by the Lord!
The Colchicum and others were a little depressed.
But at this moment.
Su Lang suddenly waved his hand, and an overwhelming array landed from the sky, directly covering the entire Qiushixian Lake!
This formation is gleaming, with faintly inky colors, sometimes turning into illusory mist, sometimes condensing into a silky thin barrier.

This immortal formation, called the Phantom Sky Lingbo United Immortal Formation, on the basis of its original defensive power, illusion concealment and concealment capabilities, and counterattack capabilities have reached a very terrifying level.
Even if a martial immortal of the Four Tribulations came, he would be trapped in it.
If it were the Wuxian of the Five Tribulations, it would not be able to break free gradually, but it would not be possible to break the formation at all, unless some powerful external force was used.

After seeing the Three Tribulations Immortal Array of the Qiucian Clan, Su Lang immediately grasped it, and merged with the former and Cangkong Phantasmal Immortal Array to create this more powerful Five Tribulations Immortal Array.

paragraphs: The original two Three Tribulations Immortal Array could not become a Five Tribulations Immortal Array no matter how they were made.
But Su Lang's formation skills had reached the supreme level.
The Three Tribulations Immortal Array of the Qiucian Clan is a combined formation of five celestial formations and a large number of quasi-celestial formations.

Therefore, after Su Lang perfected the flaws in these formations, he used each immortal formation as the skeleton, using the quasi-immortal formation and the powerful holy formation as flesh and blood, to construct this powerful Five Tribulations Immortal Formation.
"this is!?"
